label: Whatever is its own subsistent being is no RECIPIENT_4; nothing is received in it as act in…
paraphrase: OPEN analyst reading of ST I q.4 a.1 ad 3: whatever is its own subsistent being is no recipient; nothing is received in it as act in receiving potency. The passage says esse is related to other things not as recipient to received but as received to recipient; reading this of a being that is its own esse is the analyst's step.
